title: Blockadeez[DISCONTINUED]
description: This mod adds tuns of decorative blocks to Minecraft!
body:
This mod aims to add a bunch of new decorative blocks to the game, from checkered tiles to soul obsidian. You will be able to craft all these blocks to decorate (not all are craftable yet) so you can make detailed builds without needing random blocks that don't make sense!

Blocks: 

Checkered blocks: This mod adds a handful of checkered blocks/tiles. These include: Checkered tiles (regular black and white tiles), Faded Checkered tiles (A little reder white), Black tiles, white tiles (One colored tiles), Odd Checkered tiles (purple and white circled tiles with a grey background), Festive checkered tiles (green and red), Amethyst tiles, Nether checkered tiles (red and purple tiles with a swirl in the middle of each tile), Ender checkered tiles (same as nether checkered tiles, just dark blueish purple, and end stone white), Iron Tiles, Colored checkered tiles from red to green in the order of the rainbow, Glow Tiles (baby blue metal like tiles that glow), Amber light Tiles (same as glow tiles, just amber orange colors), Monochrome Swirled Tiles, Tiled slate, Diamond checkered tiles (Diamond and white), Diamond Emerald Checkered Tiles, Prismarine Checkered tiles, and finally jade checkered tiles.

Jade: Jade is a resource that will eventually be found in caves. They generate crystals instead of ores and can be made into a handful of different blocks! You can smooth them out in the stone cutter to get smooth jade (not yet implemented), which then can be made into a smoother version of the blocks! (also not yet implemented).

Bricks: Glow bricks (same as glow tiles, just bricks), iron bricks, amber light bricks, diamond bricks, and gold bricks.

Misc blocks: soul obsidian (obsidian textured as if there were souls trapped in them), smooth obsidian, rough obsidian, slate, cobbled slate, smooth slate, Radiance Stone (a blue-colored stone that glows slightly in the dark), jade block, and jade pillar.

this list is a WIP and will become cleaner with time.
